visual_concept: 一张工程师的工作桌面：笔记本电脑屏幕左侧显示复杂的工程架构图（标注80%），右侧显示一个极简的prompt输入框（标注20%）。桌上一本翻开的工程手册旁，有一个小纸片写着『prompt 200字』，另一张揉皱的纸团写着『2000字』被丢在垃圾桶边。一杯咖啡和几支笔散落，整体强调工程与prompt的时间投入对比。
image_prompt:
A FLAT EDITORIAL ILLUSTRATION in classic editorial magazine cover art style.
Ink and watercolor on textured paper, designed-not-rendered, with visible hand-drawn linework and intentional limited color palette.

This is NOT a photograph, NOT a 3D render, NOT a cinematic concept-art image.
Think the look of a printed editorial illustration on paper.

SUBJECT:
A cluttered desk viewed from above, angled slightly. On the left, a laptop screen shows a complex engineering architecture diagram (labeled '80%') with interconnected boxes and arrows. On the right side of the same screen, a minimal text box labeled '20%' contains a short line representing a prompt. On the desk around the laptop: an open engineering handbook with circuit-like diagrams, a small torn paper note reading 'prompt 200字', a crumpled paper ball labeled '2000字' in a wastebasket, a coffee mug, and scattered pens. The composition emphasizes the contrast between the large engineering system area and the tiny prompt section.

STYLE (critical — must enforce):
- FLAT ILLUSTRATION, ink and watercolor style
- visible brush strokes, paper texture, hand-drawn linework
- matte finish, designed-not-rendered
- limited color palette with intentional negative space (light background)
- NO photorealism, NO CGI, NO cinematic rendering
- NO glossy plastic, NO chrome, NO 3D realism
- NO photographic depth-of-field, NO bokeh

LIGHTING & MOOD:
- Soft natural daylight from above, expressed through flat washes of warm tones
- NOT cinematic lighting, NOT realistic shadows

COMPOSITION (the one principle: CANVAS UNITY):
- 2.35:1 horizontal aspect ratio = 47:20 (1920×816 default)

**THE WHOLE CANVAS IS ONE DESIGNED OBJECT.** Every region of the canvas has intentional purpose — either intentional content, or intentional negative space that serves the design (not accidentally empty). There must be NO disconnected islands: no floating title, no isolated character, no forgotten corner.

The viewer should read the canvas as a single unified composition, not as multiple stacked elements or compartments.

Diagnostic checks:
- Is there any part of the canvas that feels accidentally empty? The desk surface provides a natural base connecting all elements.
- Is the title text visually connected? It will be placed near the top-left, anchored by the laptop.
- Could any single element be removed without affecting the rest? No — each object reinforces the time-allocation theme.
- Does the whole canvas read as one frame? Yes, the desk acts as a unified platform.
- If I imagine cropping into thirds, each third has meaningful content: left third = engineering handbook + wastebasket, center = laptop with screen, right = coffee + scattered notes.

Universal failure modes avoided:
- Title and main subject treated as separate compartments → title integrated into the desk scene, overlapping the background slightly.
- Elements clustered on one side → balanced across the horizontal.
- A small element floating alone → every object touches the desk or another object.
- Subjects that look pasted onto the background → shadows and overlapping established.
- A 'dead middle' → laptop screen is the focal center.

COLOR PALETTE (strict, with area proportions):
- Dominant background: warm off-white (#FBF6EA) fills ≥60% — the desk surface and wall.
- Signature ink: deep ink (#2B2A26) for all linework, title text, and primary object outlines — about 20%.
- Secondary: warm gray (#9A9286) for the laptop body, engineering book, and wastebasket — about 15%.
- Single ignition accent: vermilion red (#B23A2E) used exactly once — for the '80%' label on the architecture diagram, acting as a visual anchor — ≤5%.
- NO pure black (#000000), NO pure white (#FFFFFF), NO rainbow gradients, NO neon.

TEXT IN IMAGE:
- main title: "工程八分 prompt二分" — Chinese, in Source Han Serif (思源宋体), large and dominant, occupying ≥40% of visual weight, placed near the top-left corner, overlapping the desk edge.
- corner small text: none (subtitle_text is empty).

NEGATIVE:
- NO abstract neural network diagrams
- NO glowing brain or digital head
- NO robot-human handshake
- NO circuit board background (engineering diagram is on screen only, not background)
- NO data stream / particle flows
- NO gradient geometric shapes
- NO VR goggles, NO AR headsets
- NO holographic UI floating in air
- NO futuristic city skyline
- NO chrome/metallic AI face
- NO binary code rain
- NO glossy plastic finish
- NO real-world brand logos or trademarks (laptop is generic, no Apple logo)
- NO photographic realism, NO cinematic concept art
